nodes.label: parse_option
nodes.desc: CLI flags: --cfg, --pretrained, --eval, --use-checkpoint.

nodes.label: main
nodes.desc: Distributed entry: linear lr scaling, then the train/eval loop.

nodes.label: get_config
nodes.desc: Assembles the frozen yacs config from defaults, YAML, and CLI.

nodes.label: _update_config_from_file
nodes.desc: Merges a model YAML such as swin_base_patch4_window12_384.yaml.

nodes.label: build_model
nodes.desc: Dispatches on MODEL.TYPE: swin, swinv2, swin_moe, swin_mlp.

nodes.label: train_one_epoch
nodes.desc: AMP forward/backward, grad clipping, per-step lr updates.

nodes.label: validate
nodes.desc: Reports top-1/top-5 accuracy on the ImageNet val split.

nodes.label: SwinTransformer
nodes.desc: Builds PatchEmbed, a ModuleList of BasicLayers, norm, head.

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: 4x4 strided Conv2d turns the image into patch tokens.

nodes.label: BasicLayer
nodes.desc: Alternates shift_size=0 and window_size/2 blocks per stage.

nodes.label: PatchMerging
nodes.desc: Halves resolution: concat 2x2 neighbors, norm, Linear 4C->2C.

nodes.label: Classification head
nodes.desc: Adaptive average pooling then Linear to num_classes.

nodes.label: SwinTransformerBlock
nodes.desc: Pre-norm, cyclic shift, windowed attention, residual MLP.

nodes.label: window_partition
nodes.desc: Reshapes (B,H,W,C) into non-overlapping MxM windows.

nodes.label: window_reverse
nodes.desc: Inverse reshape of windows back to the feature map.

nodes.label: SW-MSA attn_mask
nodes.desc: Buffer masking cross-region attention after the cyclic shift.

nodes.label: WindowAttention
nodes.desc: QKV projection, scaled dot-product, added relative bias.

nodes.label: relative_position_bias_table
nodes.desc: Learnable (2M-1)^2 x nH table indexed per window pair.

nodes.label: Mlp
nodes.desc: GELU feed-forward with mlp_ratio expansion (default 4x).

nodes.label: build_optimizer
nodes.desc: Chooses AdamW/SGD/FusedAdam/FusedLAMB from config.

nodes.label: set_weight_decay
nodes.desc: Zero decay for 1-D params, biases, and skip keywords.

nodes.label: build_scheduler
nodes.desc: Warmup epochs followed by the configured decay schedule.

nodes.label: LinearLRScheduler
nodes.desc: Linear warmup then linear decay to a floor rate.

nodes.label: NativeScalerWithGradNormCount
nodes.desc: torch.cuda.amp GradScaler wrapped with grad-norm clipping.

nodes.label: build_loader
nodes.desc: Datasets, DistributedSamplers, DataLoaders, mixup closure.

nodes.label: build_dataset
nodes.desc: Picks ImageNet folder, IN22K, or zip dataset; builds transforms.

nodes.label: CachedImageFolder
nodes.desc: ImageFolder variant that caches decoded images in memory.

nodes.label: IN22KDATASET
nodes.desc: Dataset reading ImageNet-22K samples from tar/zip archives.

nodes.label: Mixup
nodes.desc: timm Mixup/CutMix applied when AUG.MIXUP or CUTMIX is set.

nodes.label: load_pretrained
nodes.desc: Fine-tune loader: drops buffers, resizes tables, remaps head.

nodes.label: Bias-table resize
nodes.desc: Bicubic interpolation of relative_position_bias_table sizes.

nodes.label: load_checkpoint
nodes.desc: Restores model, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, and epoch.

nodes.label: save_checkpoint
nodes.desc: Writes ckpt_epoch_N.pth with full training state.

nodes.label: auto_resume_helper
nodes.desc: Picks the newest .pth in the output dir for auto-resume.
